## ENFORCEMENT NOTICE  
To: Ava And Team, Host of Airbnb listing ID 812864961166500325, located in Hammersmith and Fulham, London.  
Pursuant to the Deregulation Act 2015, Section 44, and the Housing Act 2004, you are hereby notified that the short‑term letting of the property exceeds the statutory maximum of 90 nights in any 12‑month period. The council’s data indicates 221 nights were booked in the preceding 365 days, resulting in 131 nights in breach of the legal limit. This contravention constitutes an unlawful use of the dwelling for short‑term accommodation without the required planning permission and may be subject to enforcement action under the aforementioned legislation.  

## EVIDENCE SUMMARY  
The Airbnb listing (ID 812864961166500325) recorded 221 nights of bookings over the last 365 days, surpassing the 90‑night cap set by the Deregulation Act 2015, s.44. The host operates a single property within the Hammersmith and Fulham borough, and the council’s algorithmic assessment assigns a confidence score of 0.97 that the data accurately reflects actual lettings. Under the Housing Act 2004, such unauthorised short‑term lets are classified as a breach of the prescribed occupancy limit, warranting formal enforcement.  

## RECOMMENDED ACTION  
Prosecution.
